# shinyOAuth

[shinyOAuth](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/) is an R package
for OpenID Connect (OIDC) authentication and OAuth 2.0 authorization in
[Shiny](https://github.com/rstudio/shiny) apps. Users can sign in with
existing accounts and give your app permission to call APIs on their
behalf.

The package works across OAuth 2.0 and OIDC providers, including
services such as Google, Microsoft, Auth0 and Okta, and self-hosted
providers such as Keycloak. You can use built-in provider helpers,
discover OIDC settings automatically, or connect to other providers by
configuring their endpoints and authentication settings yourself.

The Shiny module manages the sign-in process, from redirects and
callbacks to OIDC token validation, user information and token refresh.
Your Shiny app can use authentication status, tokens and user
information as reactive values. You can also reuse the user’s sign-in
with other R packages and database drivers that accept OAuth access
tokens. shinyOAuth supplies a current token, refreshing it when needed.

## Features

- Shiny module:
  [`oauth_module_server()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_module_server.md)
  manages login, callbacks and token refresh. It returns reactive values
  for login status, tokens and user information.

- S7 classes: `OAuthProvider`, `OAuthClient` and `OAuthToken` describe
  the provider, your app’s registration and the tokens it receives.

- Functions for custom integrations: use
  [`prepare_call()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/prepare_call.md),
  [`handle_callback()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/handle_callback.md),
  [`introspect_token()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/introspect_token.md)
  and
  [`refresh_token()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/refresh_token.md)
  to manage the flow yourself.

- Provider setup: use built-in helpers for GitHub, Google, Microsoft,
  Keycloak and Auth0, discover OIDC settings with
  [`oauth_provider_oidc_discover()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_oidc_discover.md),
  or configure a provider yourself.

- Security: AES-GCM-encrypted state, single-use server-side state,
  origin- and tab-scoped browser binding, HTTPS enforcement and PKCE
  (S256). OIDC checks cover ID token signatures and claims, including
  nonce, and match the UserInfo subject to the ID token. DPoP, mTLS, JAR
  and PAR are available for providers that require them. See
  [`vignette("authentication-flow", package = "shinyOAuth")`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/authentication-flow.md)
  ([online
  guide](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/authentication-flow.html)).

- Asynchronous execution: provider requests can run in background
  workers to keep other Shiny sessions responsive. See the [setup
  instructions](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/usage.html#asynchronous-execution).

- Diagnostics: record login successes, failures and other events with
  audit hooks or OpenTelemetry. See
  [`vignette("audit-logging", package = "shinyOAuth")`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/audit-logging.md)
  ([online
  guide](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/audit-logging.html))
  and
  [`vignette("opentelemetry", package = "shinyOAuth")`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/opentelemetry.md)
  ([online
  guide](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/opentelemetry.html)).

## Installation

Install from [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=shinyOAuth):

``` r

install.packages("shinyOAuth")
```

Install the development version from GitHub:

``` r

if (!requireNamespace("remotes", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("remotes")
}

remotes::install_github("lukakoning/shinyOAuth")
```

## Usage

See
[`vignette("usage", package = "shinyOAuth")`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/usage.md)
([online
guide](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/usage.html)) for
login buttons, authenticated API calls, configuration and deployment
settings.

### Minimal example

Register a GitHub OAuth app in your [GitHub Developer
Settings](https://github.com/settings/developers), using
`http://127.0.0.1:8100` as the callback URL. Set
`GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` and `GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET` in your R
environment before running the example. The [environment setup
instructions](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/usage.html#github-app-registration)
show how to store these values in `.Renviron`.

``` r

library(shiny)
library(shinyOAuth)

provider <- oauth_provider_github()

# App registration
client <- oauth_client(
  provider = provider,
  client_id = Sys.getenv("GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID"),
  client_secret = Sys.getenv("GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET"),
  redirect_uri = "http://127.0.0.1:8100",
  scopes = c("read:user", "user:email")
)

# Simple UI
ui <- oauth_ui(fluidPage(
  # Show login information:
  uiOutput("login_information")
), id = "auth", client = client)

# Server which obtains authentication
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # Login and callback handling, with reactive status and token data
  auth <- oauth_module_server("auth", client)

  # Render login information:
  output[["login_information"]] <- renderUI({
    if (auth[["authenticated"]]) {
      user_info <- auth[["token"]]@userinfo
      tagList(
        tags[["p"]]("You are logged in! Your details:"),
        tags[["pre"]](paste(capture.output(str(user_info)), collapse = "\n"))
      )
    } else {
      tags[["p"]]("You are not logged in.")
    }
  })
}

runApp(
  shinyApp(ui, server), port = 8100,
  launch.browser = FALSE
)

# Open the app in your regular browser at http://127.0.0.1:8100
# (viewers in RStudio/Positron/etc. cannot perform necessary redirects)
```

> On Posit Connect and Connect Cloud, the direct app URL supports the
> browser navigation used during login; embedded dashboard previews can
> block redirects. See [deployment
> settings](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/usage.html#posit-connect-and-connect-cloud).

### Logging/auditing

Use audit hooks to record callbacks and login outcomes, or send logs and
traces to a monitoring service through OpenTelemetry.

For R hook examples, see
[`vignette("audit-logging", package = "shinyOAuth")`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/audit-logging.md)
([online
guide](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/audit-logging.html)).
For exporter setup, see
[`vignette("opentelemetry", package = "shinyOAuth")`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/opentelemetry.md)
([online
guide](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/opentelemetry.html)).

## More information

[Authentication
flow](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/authentication-flow.html)
explains how the package handles login requests, callbacks and token
checks. The [deployment
guide](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/usage.html#deployment)
covers hosted app configuration. You can also read these guides in R
with
[`vignette("authentication-flow", package = "shinyOAuth")`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/authentication-flow.md)
and
[`vignette("usage", package = "shinyOAuth")`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/articles/usage.md).

### For developers: tests & integration tests

The ‘testthat’ tests are in `tests/testthat/`. Integration tests in
`integration/keycloak/` use a local Keycloak instance in Docker or
Podman and include browser tests with ‘shinytest2’ and ‘chromote’. Demo
deployments are in `integration/gcp/` for Google Cloud Run and
`integration/posit/` for Posit Connect Cloud.

# Package index

## Shiny login

The main helpers for adding login to a Shiny app.

- [`oauth_ui()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_ui.md)
  : Set up a Shiny UI for shinyOAuth
- [`oauth_module_server()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_module_server.md)
  : OAuth 2.0 authorization and OIDC authentication module for Shiny
- [`oauth_client()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_client.md)
  : Configure OAuth/OIDC client credentials and login settings

## Object reference

- [`OAuthProvider()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/OAuthProvider.md)
  : OAuthProvider S7 class
- [`OAuthClient()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/OAuthClient.md)
  : OAuthClient S7 class
- [`OAuthToken()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/OAuthToken.md)
  : OAuthToken S7 class
- [`OAuthConnection`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/OAuthConnection.md)
  : OAuthConnection R6 class

## Provider configuration

### Generic

- [`oauth_provider()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider.md)
  : Configure OAuth/OIDC provider endpoints and validation settings
- [`oauth_provider_oidc()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_oidc.md)
  : Create a generic OpenID Connect (OIDC) OAuthProvider
- [`oauth_provider_oidc_discover()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_oidc_discover.md)
  : Discover and create an OpenID Connect (OIDC) OAuthProvider

### Preconfigured

- [`oauth_provider_apple()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_apple.md)
  : Create an Apple OAuthProvider
- [`oauth_provider_auth0()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_auth0.md)
  : Create an Auth0 OAuthProvider (via OIDC discovery)
- [`oauth_provider_authentik()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_authentik.md)
  : Configure sign-in with authentik
- [`oauth_provider_cognito()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_cognito.md)
  : Configure sign-in with an Amazon Cognito user pool
- [`oauth_provider_github()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_github.md)
  : Create a GitHub OAuthProvider
- [`oauth_provider_gitlab()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_gitlab.md)
  : Configure sign-in with GitLab
- [`oauth_provider_globus()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_globus.md)
  : Configure sign-in with Globus Auth
- [`oauth_provider_google()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_google.md)
  : Create a Google OAuthProvider
- [`oauth_provider_huggingface()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_huggingface.md)
  : Configure sign-in with Hugging Face
- [`oauth_provider_keycloak()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_keycloak.md)
  : Create a Keycloak OAuthProvider (via OIDC discovery)
- [`oauth_provider_microsoft()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_microsoft.md)
  : Create a Microsoft (Entra ID) OAuthProvider
- [`oauth_provider_okta()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_okta.md)
  : Create an Okta OAuthProvider (via OIDC discovery)
- [`oauth_provider_orcid()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_orcid.md)
  : Configure researcher sign-in with ORCID
- [`oauth_provider_slack()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_slack.md)
  : Create a Slack OAuthProvider (via OIDC discovery)
- [`oauth_provider_spotify()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_spotify.md)
  : Create a Spotify OAuthProvider
- [`oauth_provider_surfconext()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_provider_surfconext.md)
  : Configure institutional sign-in with SURFconext

## Tokens and API requests

- [`oauth_connection()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_connection.md)
  : Wrap an existing reactive token as a connection

- [`get_userinfo()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/get_userinfo.md)
  : Fetch a user's profile (UserInfo)

- [`refresh_token()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/refresh_token.md)
  : Refresh an OAuth 2.0 token

- [`revoke_token()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/revoke_token.md)
  : Revoke an OAuth 2.0 token

- [`introspect_token()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/introspect_token.md)
  : Introspect an OAuth 2.0 token

- [`resource_req()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/resource_req.md)
  : Prepare an API request with an access token

- [`perform_resource_req()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/perform_resource_req.md)
  : Call an API with an access token

- [`client_bearer_req()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/client_bearer_req.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** :

  Alias for
  [`resource_req()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/resource_req.md)

- [`perform_client_bearer_req()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/perform_client_bearer_req.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** :

  Alias for
  [`perform_resource_req()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/perform_resource_req.md)

- [`oauth_token_target()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_token_target.md)
  : Declare an API token target

## Deployment helpers

- [`check_oauth21()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/check_oauth21.md)
  : Review an OAuth client configuration before deployment
- [`is_ok_host()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/is_ok_host.md)
  : Check a URL against the package's host policy
- [`custom_cache()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/custom_cache.md)
  : Create a custom state store or signing-key cache
- [`error_on_softened()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/error_on_softened.md)
  **\[deprecated\]** : Check selected debugging options (deprecated)

## Multiple retained connections

- [`oauth_connections()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_connections.md)
  [`print(`*`<OAuthConnections>`*`)`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_connections.md)
  : Manage several OAuth connections in one Shiny app
- [`oauth_connections_ui()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_connections_ui.md)
  : Handle callbacks and establish the connection owner's browser
  session
- [`oauth_connections_server()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_connections_server.md)
  : Connect, restore and use several OAuth authorizations in a Shiny
  session
- [`oauth_connection_store_memory()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_connection_store_memory.md)
  [`print(`*`<OAuthConnectionStore>`*`)`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_connection_store_memory.md)
  : Create a process-local store for retained OAuth connections
- [`oauth_browser_owner()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_browser_owner.md)
  [`oauth_account_owner()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_browser_owner.md)
  [`print(`*`<OAuthOwnerPolicy>`*`)`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_browser_owner.md)
  : Configure ownership of retained OAuth connections

## SMART on FHIR

- [`smart_discover()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/smart_discover.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Discover SMART on FHIR server metadata
- [`smart_client()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/smart_client.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Configure a SMART on FHIR app registration
- [`smart_launch_route()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/smart_launch_route.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Register a SMART EHR launch entry route
- [`smart_context()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/smart_context.md)
  [`smart_patient()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/smart_context.md)
  [`smart_fhir_user()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/smart_context.md)
  **\[experimental\]** : Read a connection's current SMART context

## Advanced login handling

Helpers for POST callbacks and custom login flows.

- [`oauth_form_post_ui()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_form_post_ui.md)
  : Wrap a Shiny UI to enable OAuth 2.0/OIDC form_post callbacks
- [`use_shinyOAuth()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/use_shinyOAuth.md)
  : Add JavaScript dependency to the UI of a Shiny app
- [`prepare_call()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/prepare_call.md)
  : Prepare an OAuth 2.0 authorization request and build its URL
- [`prepare_authorization_request()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/prepare_authorization_request.md)
  : Prepare a browser authorization request using GET or POST
- [`handle_callback()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/handle_callback.md)
  : Validate an OAuth 2.0 callback and retrieve tokens

## Provider-specific client settings

- [`oauth_client_mtls_registration()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_client_mtls_registration.md)
  : Prepare client-certificate registration settings (mTLS)
- [`oauth_client_secret_apple()`](https://lukakoning.github.io/shinyOAuth/reference/oauth_client_secret_apple.md)
  : Create a client secret for Sign in with Apple
